224:t_10:34.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Is it... all right for me to stay your brother?」

224:t_10:35.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Of course! You're my big brother, and you always will be.」

224:t_10:36.en:
$$ランカ$$
「You have to come back safely, Big Bro. This time, I'll bake a pineapple cake for both my big brothers.」

224:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...She's grown into a fine young lady.」

224:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ランカ$$ grew into such a cheerful, honest young woman thanks to your efforts, $$オズマ$$.」

224:t_10:41.en:
$$オズマ$$
「...That's not true. All I did was atone for taking away her smile.」

224:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please don't put yourself down like that. I'm sure $$ランカ$$ would be sad to hear someone disparage her family.」

224:t_10:44.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're welcome. I'm a fan of $$ランカ$$ too, after all.」

224:t_10:46.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I know. Soon, $$ランカ$$ will leave my nest...」

224:t_10:47.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Neither I nor $$ブレラ$$ will be the one beside her then. And whoever it is, it probably won't be my place to interfere.」

224:t_10:48.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As a brother, a man, and a superior officer... It's complicated in so many ways.」

224:t_10:49.en:
$$オズマ$$
「But it's not a bad feeling. ...I'll come back alive so I can watch over that day.」

224:t_10:51.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's lift our spirits! Let's put our all into another day of...」

224:t_10:52.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Business, business! Fire it up! Bomber!!」

225:t_000:0.en:
$$ランカ$$
「So these are $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins...」

225:t_000:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「I hear this planet is hidden in a gas cloud and isn't recorded in any observational data.」

225:t_000:2.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Why would they build something like this... on a planet like that...?」

225:t_000:3.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Chief of Staff $$エキセドル$$ says this type of ruin seems to be some kind of recording device.」

225:t_000:4.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Then they really did... build it to leave something behind.」

225:t_000:5.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Even though it might never reach anyone...」

225:t_000:7.en:
$$シン$$
「So why did you volunteer for the ruins expedition too, $n?」

225:t_000:8.en:
$n
「As an occult fan, I can't sit still when I hear about ruins of a prehistoric civilization.」

225:t_000:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's our 《$$ナイト$$》. Same here.」

225:t_000:10.en:
$$レド$$
「What is this '$$ナイト$$'? It seems to be another name for $n...」

225:t_000:11.en:
$n
「It's the other name I use online.」

225:t_000:12.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「You're pretty open about it. A lot of people hide that sort of thing as their $$黒歴史$$.」

225:t_000:14.en:
$$キラ$$
「In the $$ＡＤＷ$$, '$$黒歴史$$' means a past you want to hide.」

225:t_000:15.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Huh... Different worlds have different ways of using words.」

225:t_000:18.en:
$$シン$$
「That doesn't mean you should bring $$セツコ$$ too. Are you trying to have a girl on each arm, with Miss $$スズネ$$ and $$セツコ$$?」

225:t_000:20.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Calm down, $$シン$$. $$セツコ$$ volunteered herself.」

225:t_000:22.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Y-yes... I was... a little interested too.」

225:t_000:29.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「$n has gotten pretty bold.」

225:t_000:30.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「It's proof he's grown since the $$時獄戦役$$.」

225:t_000:32.en:
$$キラ$$
「That's enough from you too, $$シン$$. $$ルナマリア$$ is about to get annoyed.」

225:t_000:34.en:
$$アマタ$$
「But sending out all our forces for a simple investigation...」

225:t_000:35.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「And every battleship except the $$クォーター$$ is waiting in the upper atmosphere.」

225:t_000:37.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Do you sense something, my friend?」

225:t_000:38.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Yeah... I'm sure $n and $$セツコ$$ do too.」

225:t_000:40.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Does $$セツコ$$ sense something in these ruins too...?)

225:t_000:41.en:
$$スズネ$$
(What $n and $$セツコ$$ have in common... The $$スフィア$$...)

225:t_000:42.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Then, since I'm not a $$リアクター$$, what am I feeling anxious about...?)

225:t_000:43.en:
$n
「Shall we get going, $$アルト$$, $$ミレーヌ$$?」

225:t_000:44.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Roger. Leave the guiding to me and $$ガムリン$$. We've been inside ruins like these before.」

225:t_000:45.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You seem... pretty cheerful, $$ミレーヌ$$.」

225:t_000:47.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
(Because the ruins on $$惑星ラクス$$ were where $$ガムリン$$ first called me just '$$ミレーヌ$$'...)

225:t_000:50.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Nothing... I just thought you looked kind of dopey.」

225:t_000:52.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「M-Miss $$ミレーヌ$$, that's enough. Let's head for the ruins.」

225:t_000:53.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Hee hee... Today you're adding 'Miss,' huh?」

225:t_000:56.en:
$$アルト$$
「Captain $$ガムリン$$ and $$ミレーヌ$$ have a nice thing going...」

225:t_000:58.en:
$$アルト$$
「Did that take your mind off things a little, $$ランカ$$?」
